newsitem.title: USA: Chicago City Council okays $490 mln of debt sales.
newsitem.headline: Chicago City Council okays $490 mln of debt sales.

text.p: The Chicago City Council on Wednesday approved $490 million of debt issuance for the coming year.

According to a spokesman for the council's finance committee, aldermen approved up to $125 million of sales tax revenue bonds for general city infrastructure programs, $250 million of general obligation tender notes, $40 million of capital equipment notes, and up to $75 million of GO bonds for library projects.
Walter Knorr, Chicago's chief financial officer, has said all the debt should be sold in the first quarter of 1997.

The city previously tapped Goldman, Sachs & Co. as senior manager for the sales tax bonds, LaSalle Capital Markets for the library GO bonds, PaineWebber Inc for the tender notes and Reinoso & Co. for the equipment notes.
